project_type: Python hexagonal-architecture orchestration engine (KiroCrew Flow) — zero-token issue polling + one-shot dispatch over Kiro Crew. Not standalone.
language: Python 3.12 (requires-python >=3.12; system default is 3.9, use pyenv shim python3.12)
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml. No compiled build; install editable with dev extras: `python3.12 -m pip install -e '.[dev]'`.
test_framework: pytest (+ pytest-cov, pytest-asyncio). Tests in flow/tests/. Convention: classes TestX, functions test_*, addopts=-v. Domain/adapters tested WITHOUT network by mock.patch.object on transport modules.
verification_instructions: From .kiro/steering/arquitetura.md 'Rodar o CI localmente': (1) python3.12 -m ruff check flow/  (2) python3.12 -m mypy flow/ --ignore-missing-imports  (3) python3.12 -m pytest flow/tests/test_domain_boundary.py -v  (4) python3.12 -m pytest flow/tests/ --cov=flow --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=75. All four must pass; ruff must be zero-warning.
snapshot_or_generated_files: docs/diagramas/*.png are derived from resources/mermaid/*.mmd but are NOT touched by this task. No test snapshots. null relevant to this change.
setup_instructions: Use python3.12 (pyenv shim at /root/.pyenv/shims/python3.12). Run `python3.12 -m pip install -e '.[dev]'` from repo root /projects/sandbox/kirocrew-flow. gh CLI is installed and on PATH.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET — pip install of dev deps is available. System python3 is 3.9 and lacks pytest; MUST use python3.12. gh CLI present but NOT authenticated (transport is mocked in tests, so no live gh calls needed). No Docker in this project (no Dockerfile).
contribution_requirements: Domain isolation is INVIOLABLE (test_domain_boundary.py): files in flow/domain/ must NOT import flow.adapters, aiohttp, subprocess, socket, requests, httpx or any I/O lib. All external decision inputs are INJECTED as parameters to pure functions, never fetched inside domain. Dataclasses use frozen=True, slots=True. Label enums use StrEnum. ruff must be clean. Coverage >=75%. New provider surface must be mirrored in test_provider_parity.py (CLIENTS table) if adapter surface changes — but only IF the change adds a provider method used by the parity contract.
key_patterns: Reviewer flow is split: (a) domain executor.decide() decides MERGE_PR vs NOTIFY_HUMAN vs DISPATCH_REVIEWER — pure, no I/O, receives state_comment + pr_head_sha injected by deployment. (b) ReviewerResult (flow/audit/state_comment.py) carries approved/comments/sha; is_auto_mergeable = approved and no comments. (c) flow/prompts/reviewer.md is the one-shot LLM prompt (the agent that reads diff + PR comments and writes ReviewerResult + adds crewflow:reviewed). (d) deployment.py driving adapter: _dispatch_reviewer, _post_reviewer_result_on_pr (posts full review to PR via github_client.upsert_pr_review_comment + calls _update_issue_with_pr_ref to update issue state comment), _execute_auto_merges (MERGE_PR path: posts to PR, merges squash, updates labels). github_transport.py wraps gh CLI (patchable). render_pr_review_comment builds the PR comment body; render_issue_pr_reference builds the short issue reference. NOTE: there is currently NO CI-check function anywhere despite the issue narrative implying _check_pr_ci exists — it must be created.
directory_structure: flow/domain (pure rules: state.py, gates.py), flow/ports (IssueProvider Protocol), flow/adapters (github_/jira_ transport+normalization+client), flow/scan (zero-token polling + SQLite cache), flow/executor (decide() per template), flow/audit (state_comment render/parse + ReviewerResult), flow/prompts (dev.md/reviewer.md/rework.md + loader), flow/config (SquadConfig + workflow templates), flow/tests (pytest). deployment/deployment.py is the driving adapter (cron). README.md + .kiro/steering/{fluxo,arquitetura}.md are docs that must stay consistent.
